audit_metadata.title: Phase 9.1 / 9.1.4.2 Classification Label Audit & Uncertainty Semantics Closure
audit_metadata.audit_objective: Audit canonical lake-condition classification targets (STABLE, EXPANDING, UNUSUAL_CHANGE, plus explicit AMBIGUOUS exclusion state), verify GLO AREA_UNCERTAINTY semantics against Rawlins et al. (2026), separate operational heuristics from physical ML classes, and enforce leakage prevention.

target_definitions.combined_delineation_uncertainty_u_rms: U_RMS = 0.5 * sqrt(u_s1_t^2 + u_s1_t1^2 + u_s2_t^2 + u_s2_t1^2) [km²] (descriptive RMS empirical delineation-error scale from Rawlins et al., 2026 Eq. 1; NOT a 1-sigma Gaussian SD)

candidate_classes.STABLE: Annual lake area change within the 1.0x U_RMS empirical delineation-error floor (|delta| <= 1.0 * U_RMS) OR within +/-5.0% relative change (|rel| <= 5.0%) OR moderate annual contraction (-3.0 * U_RMS <= delta < 0 and rel >= -20.0%; project-defined convention).
candidate_classes.EXPANDING: Positive annual expansion exceeding the 1.0x U_RMS empirical delineation-error floor and +5.0% relative change, bounded above by 3.0x U_RMS and +20.0% relative change.
candidate_classes.UNUSUAL_CHANGE: Threshold-defined unusual change: extreme annual expansion (>3.0x U_RMS and >20.0% relative) or extreme annual contraction (<-3.0x U_RMS and <-20.0% relative). Not independently verified hazard or GLOF events.
candidate_classes.AMBIGUOUS: Label-exclusion state (not a 4th learned physical class) for observations failing to satisfy physical class conjunctions. Explicitly tracked (N=897, 7.57% of overall matched cohort) and excluded from 3-class supervised training.

measurement_uncertainty_findings.source_formula: AREA_UNCERTAINTY(A) = round(0.0488 * A^0.537, 3) [km²] (Rawlins et al., 2026, ESSD 18:5143-5165, Eq. 1; verified 100.0000% across all 40,423 GLO v1.02 records)

observed_serial_dependence_diagnostics.interpretation: Observed serial dependence diagnostics indicate that the derived cross-sensor discrepancies and annual changes are not temporally independent as observed quantities. These diagnostics do not independently identify the covariance of the underlying measurement errors.

measurement_uncertainty_findings.scientific_interpretation: Over 90% of observed annual changes in the 11,849 matched cohort are smaller than the 1.0x U_RMS empirical delineation-error scale. Because GLO AREA_UNCERTAINTY is an empirical delineation-error estimate (not a 1-sigma Gaussian SD) and independence is not established by the source, U_RMS is used purely as a descriptive RMS empirical delineation-error scale without Gaussian sigma or covariance claims. See reports/12_uncertainty_semantics_note.md.

operational_rules_vs_ground_truth_isolat.rule_based_risk_engine_status: RiskEngine statuses (SAFE, NORMAL, WATCH, ELEVATED_ALERT, STALE, STALE_DATA, INSUFFICIENT_DATA; plus legacy persisted read compatibility for 'UNUSUAL_CHANGE' mapped to 'ELEVATED ALERT') are heuristic operational alert tiers combining sensor discordance, staleness, and operational thresholds. New RiskEngine elevated alerts emit canonical 'ELEVATED_ALERT'. Operational alert statuses must NEVER be used as supervised training targets.
operational_rules_vs_ground_truth_isolat.abstention_separation: WATCH, STALE, STALE_DATA, and INSUFFICIENT_DATA are operational quality/alert states, NOT physical lake-change categories.
operational_rules_vs_ground_truth_isolat.independent_target_formulation: Supervised labels are constructed strictly from consecutive annual area observations and GLO AREA_UNCERTAINTY, completely independent of RiskEngine and separate from cryospheric event catalogues.

asymmetry_and_contraction_handling.physical_reality: Annual lake area time series contain both positive and negative year-to-year changes arising from delineation error, water-level variation, and physical lake evolution. Annual area observations alone do not establish the physical cause of an individual contraction.
asymmetry_and_contraction_handling.label_assignment: Grouping moderate annual contraction (-3.0x U_RMS <= delta < 0 and rel >= -20.0%) into STABLE is a project-defined classification convention. Only extreme annual contraction (<-3.0x U_RMS AND <-20.0%) triggers threshold-defined UNUSUAL_CHANGE.

test_2023_exhausted_historical_reference.usage_policy: PROHIBITED for any further evaluation, threshold selection, hyperparameter tuning, or model selection; NB09/NB11 metrics preserved as historical references only.

class_imbalance.canonical_reconciliation_note: Earlier superseded draft values (STABLE=10,764 / EXPANDING=577 / UNUSUAL=508, 0 AMBIGUOUS) conflated Category C small-lake negative contractions with UNUSUAL_CHANGE and forced positive ambiguous records into EXPANDING. Canonical reconciliation resolves all 11,849 matched observations into mutually exclusive physical classes (STABLE=10,760 [90.81%], EXPANDING=77 [0.65%], UNUSUAL_CHANGE=115 [0.97%]) plus 897 [7.57%] explicit AMBIGUOUS exclusions.
class_imbalance.mitigation_plan: Training-only balanced class weights (computed strictly on Train <=2021 unambiguous N=7,880), cost-sensitive loss, and PR-AUC / macro-F1 optimization. Synthetic oversampling (SMOTE) is strictly prohibited on validation/test partitions.

temporal_guardrails.exhausted_test_2023_prohibition: The 2023 historical test cohort (N=1,742) was already used in NB09 and NB11. Any further test-set evaluation, threshold selection, hyperparameter tuning, or model selection using 2023 is strictly prohibited.
temporal_guardrails.status_of_2024: 2024 area observations were consumed to form the 2023 target and lack 2025 next-year observations; 2024 remains unavailable as an untouched future holdout.
